start: Profile, Body, a member with two weigh-ins

user_sees: Chips for body weight and the ten measures; a graph; 'History'
must_not: A graph drawn from one point with no words

user_sees: Page 'Add measures' 'Fill in any you like.' with 'Date', Body weight and the measures, 'Add picture', 'Save'
must_not: The date set to a day other than today

steps.action: Type body weight 82.5 and tap Save
user_sees: Back on Body, the new weigh-in in History and on the graph

start: Body page, a gym member whose trainer recorded measurements (gym feature trainerPlans on)

steps.action: Open Body and pick a measure the trainer took
user_sees: The trainer's entries in History marked with the gym's name (From my gym)
'Tap your own entry to fix or delete it. Ask your gym to change the ones they recorded.'
must_not: A trainer entry that the member can edit or delete
The gym's entries shown when the gym feature is off

steps.action: Tap Save with every box empty and no picture
user_sees: 'Nothing to save' 'Type at least one measure, or add a picture.'

steps.action: Type 0 or letters in Waist and tap Save
user_sees: 'Check the numbers' 'Waist: type a number above 0, like 82.5.'
must_not: A zero or negative measure saved

steps.action: Type body weight 8.25 when the last was 82.5
user_sees: A typo check asks, with 'Keep it' and 'Fix it'
must_not: The odd weight saved with no question

start: Body page, an own weigh-in in History

must_not: The sheet opening for a gym entry

user_sees: It leaves the list; an Undo bar
must_not: 'Couldn’t delete it. Please try again.' after a delete that worked

start: Add measures for a day that already has a weigh-in
